{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Strip commas from revenue and convert to float (for safety, even though not needed for conversion rate)
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Drop the six QA orders with revenue = 999999.99 (they are not real)
qa_mask = sales['revenue'] == 999999.99
sales_clean = sales[~qa_mask].copy()

# Drop refunded orders (status == 'refunded') since they are not conversions
converted_mask = sales_clean['status'] == 'completed'
sales_converted = sales_clean[converted_mask].copy()

# Calculate conversion rate by customer_segment
# Conversion rate = number of converted orders / total orders per segment
conversion_rates = sales_converted.groupby('customer_segment').size() / sales_clean.groupby('customer_segment').size()

# Find the segment with the highest conversion rate
best_segment = conversion_rates.idxmax()

# Print the conversion rates for verification
conversion_rates.sort_values(ascending=False)"}
